title: The Biggest Pricing Mistake Sellers Make 😳
description:
Why Overpricing Your Home Can Cost You Money

One of the most expensive mistakes a seller can make is overpricing their home from the start.

Many homeowners think pricing higher leaves room to negotiate. In reality, it can cause buyers to skip your listing altogether while other homes get the attention.

The longer a home sits on the market, the more buyers begin to wonder why.

Strategic pricing isn't about leaving money on the table—it's about creating the strongest opportunity to attract buyers and maximize your result.
